2609.08646.title: Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection
2609.08646.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.
2609.08646.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地以階層化指令的方式部署，但它們仍然容易受到用戶指令覆蓋系統級約束的衝突影響。現有的防禦機制主要集中在靜態輸入檢查，因此無法檢測到回應漂移（Response Drift），這是一種現象，即模型的最終回應違反了系統級約束，儘管輸入看似符合要求。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了ELCD，一種用於生成後、交付前驗證的回應級潛在衝突檢測器。給定完整的生成輸出，ELCD通過將最終標記嵌入與平均池化的回應嵌入連接來構建一個復合隱藏狀態表示。然後，它優化一個成對邊際排名目標，以在潛在空間中區分合規和漂移的回應。對五個主流LLM（參數範圍從1.5B到14B）的廣泛實驗表明，ELCD顯著優於競爭基準。值得注意的是，它在Llama-2-7B上的PR-AUC提高了約30個百分點，並將Mistral-7B在95% TPR（FPR95）下的假陽性率降低至2.67%。這些結果表明，ELCD為開放權重或自托管LLM部署中的潛在指令衝突檢測提供了一種有前景的方法。
